items.t: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship
items.d: Ukraine's president told the BBC the US is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks, as Ukraine braces for another hard winter.

items.t: Hundreds of thousands still without power after US storms
items.d: Pennsylvania and neighbouring states remain worst hit after Thanksgiving storms lashed both coasts, disrupting holiday travel.

items.t: EU leaders fail to agree budget as Ukraine aid splits talks
items.d: Disputes including aid for Ukraine stalled the EU's long-term budget talks; members still hope to reach a deal by year end.

items.t: Spain's leaders clash in final debate before Sunday vote
items.d: Housing costs dominated a bitter campaign; Pedro Sánchez trails in polls but insists the left can still win a majority.

items.t: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge
items.d: The ousted PM plans to go home in December, deepening Dhaka-Delhi tensions and raising fears of fresh unrest.

items.t: Colombian police free 76 supermarket hostages after 17 hours
items.d: One gunman was killed when police stormed the store after a failed robbery of an armoured cash van.

items.t: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec religious symbols ban
items.d: The ruling backs a law barring some public servants, including teachers, from wearing religious symbols at work.

items.t: Why Trump's new tariffs pose less of a threat
items.d: Countries have rerouted trade since his first tariff wave and are now planning for the post-Trump era.

items.t: SAP weighs cutting 10,000 jobs in AI overhaul
items.d: Europe's biggest software firm is reportedly preparing to cut about 9% of staff to refocus on AI.

items.t: Binance restores withdrawals after record $6.3bn hack
items.d: The crypto exchange says recovery work is complete a month after the largest crypto theft on record.

items.t: Banks see S&P 500 at 8,200-8,700 by end of 2027
items.d: JPMorgan, Goldman and Morgan Stanley published bullish 2027 targets, all assuming the AI investment cycle holds.

items.t: SpaceX cleared for up to a million data-centre satellites
items.d: The FCC approved SpaceX's orbital AI-compute constellation despite objections from Amazon, Viasat and astronomers.

items.t: Neuralink wins FDA nod for first pivotal brain-implant trial
items.d: The US trial will test its brain-computer interface in adults with ALS, a key step towards approval.

items.t: OpenAI admits GPT-6.2 billing error, tightens ChatGPT limits
items.d: A launch mistake over-discounted usage; paying users may now hit limits up to 40% faster.

items.t: 42 US states fight Character.AI auction of users' chats
items.d: Attorneys general asked a bankruptcy court to block the sale of 21 million accounts, 2.1 million of them minors'.

items.t: Octopus cyberattack exposes data of 7,500 Hong Kong users
items.d: Names and photos leaked, plus some auto top-up details; it follows a 90,000-user SmartPLAY breach.

items.t: FIFA confirms hackers accessed personal data
items.d: Football's governing body says attackers reached personal and business information; a new group has claimed it.

items.t: NHS warns of 'horrible spike' in flu
items.d: Hospital admissions are surging and officials urge at-risk people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

items.t: NASA to test space crop chamber and mini brains on ISS
items.d: The NG-25 cargo mission will carry a prototype crop-growing system and lab-grown brain tissue for Moon and Mars research.

items.t: Badenoch: Tory candidates must pledge to scrap net zero
items.d: The Conservative leader's 'candidates covenant' drew criticism from some former MPs.

items.t: No 10 says it has no interest in Huw Edwards interviews
items.d: Downing Street joined a backlash against new interviews with the disgraced former BBC presenter.

items.t: Ex-council leader Jason Zadrozny jailed for fraud
items.d: The former Ashfield council leader was sentenced to 27 months for fraud and tax evasion.

items.t: 澤連斯基批評特朗普與普京「奇怪」友誼
items.d: 烏克蘭總統接受BBC訪問時表示，美國在和談中對俄羅斯施壓不足；烏克蘭正面對另一個艱難寒冬。

items.t: 美國風暴過後 數十萬戶仍未恢復供電
items.d: 感恩節風暴吹襲美國東西兩岸，賓夕法尼亞州及鄰近州份災情最嚴重，假期出行大受影響。

items.t: 歐盟領袖未能就預算達成共識
items.d: 包括援助烏克蘭在內的分歧令歐盟長期預算談判陷入僵局，成員國仍希望年底前達成協議。

items.t: 西班牙大選前最後辯論 各黨領袖激烈交鋒
items.d: 住屋問題主導選情，首相桑切斯民調落後，但堅稱左派陣營仍能取得多數議席。

items.t: 哈西娜計劃回國 孟加拉局勢緊張
items.d: 被推翻的前總理計劃12月返回孟加拉，加深孟印緊張關係，並引發再起動盪的憂慮。

items.t: 哥倫比亞警方突入超市 救出76名人質
items.d: 劫匪搶劫運鈔車失敗後挾持人質17小時，警方突入超市，一名槍手被擊斃。

items.t: 加拿大最高法院大致維持魁北克宗教標誌禁令
items.d: 裁決支持禁止教師等部分公務員在工作時佩戴宗教標誌的法例。

items.t: 分析：為何特朗普新關稅威脅減弱
items.d: 各國自首輪關稅後已調整貿易流向，繞過美國關稅壁壘，並開始為特朗普卸任後作部署。

items.t: SAP據報擬裁員一萬人 轉型AI
items.d: 據報歐洲最大軟件公司SAP準備削減約9%人手，以重新聚焦人工智能業務。

items.t: Binance遭63億美元黑客盜竊後恢復提款
items.d: 加密貨幣交易所Binance表示，上月遭遇史上最大宗加密貨幣盜竊後，復原工作已完成，提款全面恢復。

items.t: 大行預測標普500指數2027年底達8200至8700點
items.d: 摩根大通、高盛及摩根士丹利發表樂觀目標，前提是AI投資周期持續。

items.t: SpaceX獲批發射最多一百萬枚數據中心衛星
items.d: 美國聯邦通訊委員會批准SpaceX的太空AI運算衛星群，Amazon、Viasat及天文學界曾表示反對。

items.t: Neuralink獲FDA批准進行首個關鍵腦機接口試驗
items.d: 試驗將在美國漸凍人症成年患者身上測試腦機接口，是邁向正式批准的重要一步。

items.t: OpenAI承認GPT-6.2計費出錯 收緊ChatGPT用量
items.d: OpenAI表示推出時錯誤地多計折扣，付費用戶現時觸及用量上限的速度最多快四成。

items.t: 美國42州反對Character.AI拍賣用戶對話
items.d: 各州總檢察長要求破產法庭阻止出售逾2100萬個帳戶，其中210萬屬未成年人。

items.t: 八達通遭網絡攻擊 約7500名客戶資料外洩
items.d: 外洩資料包括姓名和相片，部分涉及自動增值資料；康文署SmartPLAY亦有約9萬用戶資料外洩。

items.t: 國際足協證實遭黑客入侵個人資料
items.d: FIFA表示黑客取得個人及商業資料，一個新黑客組織聲稱責任。

items.t: 英國醫療服務警告流感「急劇飆升」
items.d: 入院人數急增，當局呼籲高危人士盡快接種疫苗。

items.t: NASA將在太空站測試太空種植艙及迷你腦組織
items.d: NG-25貨運任務將運送種植系統原型及實驗室培養的腦組織，為登月及火星任務研究鋪路。

items.t: 貝丁諾要求保守黨候選人承諾廢除淨零目標
items.d: 保守黨領袖推出「候選人公約」，被部分前議員批評。

items.t: 唐寧街：無興趣聽愛德華茲發言
items.d: 首相府加入批評行列，反對身敗名裂的前BBC主播接受新訪問。

items.t: 前議會領袖扎德羅茲尼欺詐罪成入獄
items.d: 阿什菲爾德前議會領袖因欺詐及逃稅被判監27個月。
